name: Alertmanager
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: Groups, silences and routes the alerts Prometheus sends to email, chat and webhooks. The web interface and API are behind a password.
startup:
pw="{{WEB_PASSWORD}}"; if [ -z "$pw" ]; then [ -s web-password.txt ] || (umask 077; head -c 18 /dev/urandom | base64 | tr -d "
/+=" > web-password.txt); pw=$(cat web-password.txt); echo "Web password is empty, so Alertmanager uses the password in web-password.txt (username {{WEB_USER}})."; fi; h=$(PW="$pw" perl -e 'my @a = ("a".."z", "A".."Z", 0..9, ".", "/"); print crypt($ENV{PW}, "\$2b\$10\$" . join("", map { $a[rand @a] } 1..22));'); printf "# Raptor writes this file at every start, from Web username and Web password.
basic_auth_users:
  "%s": "%s"
" "{{WEB_USER}}" "$h" > web-auth.yml; exec ./alertmanager --config.file=alertmanager.yml --storage.path=data --web.listen-address=0.0.0.0:{{SERVER_PORT}} --web.config.file=web-auth.yml --cluster.listen-address= ${EXTERNAL_URL:+--web.external-url="$EXTERNAL_URL"} --data.retention={{RETENTION}}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Alertmanager: downloads the release for the chosen version from GitHub
# (checked against GitHub's checksum). alertmanager.yml and the data folder
# (silences, notification log) are never touched; only the alertmanager and
# amtool programs are replaced, once the new ones have arrived.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
work=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
rm -rf "$work" && mkdir -p "$work"
trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
case "$(uname -m)" in
    x86_64) arch=amd64 ;;
    aarch64) arch=arm64 ;;
    *) fail "Alertmanager has no build for this CPU ($(uname -m))." ;;
esac

want="${VERSION:-latest}"
tag=latest
if [ "$want" != latest ]; then tag="v${want#v}"; fi
tag=$(gh-release tag prometheus/alertmanager "$tag") || fail "Alertmanager has no version $want. Set Version to latest, or to a release such as 0.35.0, then reinstall."
version="${tag#v}"

if [ -x alertmanager ] && ./alertmanager --version 2>&1 | grep -q "version $version "; then
    echo "Alertmanager $version is already installed."
else
    echo "Downloading Alertmanager $version"
    gh-release download prometheus/alertmanager "$tag" "alertmanager-$version.linux-$arch.tar.gz" "$work/am.tar.gz"
    tar -xzf "$work/am.tar.gz" -C "$work" --strip-components=1
    [ -x "$work/alertmanager" ] || fail "The download isn't Alertmanager. Reinstall to try again."
    mv -f "$work/amtool" amtool
    mv -f "$work/alertmanager" alertmanager
fi

mkdir -p data
if [ ! -f alertmanager.yml ]; then
    cat > alertmanager.yml <<'YML'
# Alertmanager's settings: https://prometheus.io/docs/alerting/latest/configuration/
# Add receivers (email, Slack, webhooks...) and route alerts to them.
route:
  receiver: "none"
  group_by: ["alertname"]

receivers:
  # Alerts are received and shown, but sent nowhere, until you add a receiver.
  - name: "none"
YML
fi
echo "Installed Alertmanager $version."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The Alertmanager version to install, such as 0.35.0, or latest. Reinstall to change it.

variables.name: Web username
variables.description: The username for the web interface and API.

variables.name: Web password
variables.description: The password for the web interface and API. Leave it empty to use a random one, saved in web-password.txt.

variables.name: Address
variables.description: The public address of Alertmanager, starting with http or https, used in links in notifications. Empty uses the server's own.

variables.name: Data retention
variables.description: How long silences and the notification log are kept, such as 120h.
